assessment: accepted after two important input/restart validation defects were corrected

scope.standalone_wheel_smoke: separate root-owned verification; not claimed by this review

issues.problem: Fresh zero-state runs accepted a weather provider beginning after sowing, silently omitting early development.
issues.initial_evidence: Ten included 10-C days accumulated TPV100; omitting the first three days yielded TPV70 for the same calendar endpoint without rejection.
issues.resolution: Fresh provider coverage must start at or before sowing.
issues.verification: Fresh-state weather coverage must begin at or before sowing.

issues.problem: Checkpoints with impossible or mutually inconsistent component/output states were accepted despite matching config/code/weather-prefix identities.
issues.initial_evidence: TPV1000 > TPP50 and last archived output TPV100 accepted during independent reproduction.
issues.resolution: Restore enforces clock ordering, canonical initial states at zero consumed days, terminal component/output agreement, and window/stage/leaf history consistency before swapping live components.

verification.late_start_rejected: Fresh-state weather coverage must begin at or before sowing.
verification.clock_order_rejected: Phenology checkpoint clocks must obey TPV <= TPP <= GDD.
verification.terminal_output_rejected: Checkpoint development clocks disagree with terminal daily output.
verification.nonzero_empty_state_rejected: Empty checkpoint differs from canonical initial component states.

scientific_interpretation: Local source is relative infected-residue potential coupled to living-canopy disease; no measured autonomous soil population or spore count is inferred.
Imported daily pressure inherits configured background only when omitted; explicit zero overrides it.
Secondary infection requires current infectious living-canopy donor tissue; temperature-driven progression can continue without current infection exposure.
F1-F7 and juvenile capacity are declared stage/rank scenarios. Node stages31/32/33 are not actual leaf counts; effective TPV spacing is not measured thermal phyllochron.
Latent, symptomatic/damage, susceptible and total affected fractions are explicit separate outputs. First infection/symptom dates use an assumed detection fraction, not observed infection dates.

HAD/yield tracking is disabled by default. External-area mode requires reference LAI and functional fractions; proxy mode declares equal nominal top-three allocation and uses symptomatic/damage tissue only. Neither mode supplies an actual local field-yield forecast.
An incomplete anthesis65-to-BBCH85 window yields missing conditional loss. Relative loss requires an independently supplied positive reference yield.

Parker2004 cultivar slopes are transferred sensitivity parameters. The restricted anthesis-to85 rectangular window differs from the source GS31-start trapezoidal TOP3-HAD definition; slope range is not a confidence interval.
declared_limitations: Residue readiness/aging rates are fixed effective phenomenology, not separately identified sexual maturation or overwinter survival parameters.
The zero-base disease clock freezes thermal progression below0 C; this is an explicit approximation rather than an empirically universal winter response.
Natural final-leaf senescence and actual green-leaf-area magnitude are not identified. Capacity after BBCH85 should not be interpreted as observed green area.
Disease/Erlang progression is a finite-step operator, not an exact continuous-time multi-compartment solution. Fixed-step fitted coefficients should retain their fitted integration step.
Source route flows are simulated allocations under a specified transmission hypothesis; they do not establish ecological causal attribution or independently calibrated source quantities.
APSIM/PCSE references support component architecture only; equivalent scientific maturity or validation is not established.
